title: Eggshell, Not Satin
mood: flirty, giddy and a little shameless
subject: inventing a new paint project every Saturday to flirt with the man at the hardware store mixing counter
caption: Retro disco-pop in the polished 2025 Hollywood-studio style. Live four-on-the-floor drums with an open hi-hat on every off-beat; an octave-jumping slap bass locked to the kick; a scratchy sixteenth-note funk rhythm guitar; a string section playing short rising stabs and long sweeps into each chorus; a clavinet comping between vocal lines. Polished and roomy, wide strings, bass and kick forward, a light plate reverb on the voice. Female voice, a breathy, wry light soprano, talking her way through the verses and opening into a bright stacked chorus. 116 BPM, A minor. Flirty, giddy and a little shameless. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM build or drop, no synthwave arpeggios, no house piano.
lyrics:
[Intro - slap bass and string stabs]

[Verse 1]
Saturday at ten, I'm at the counter again
Last week the kitchen, now the hallway needs a lift
He shakes the can like he's playing maracas
Asks me what the room is for, I say I haven't decided

[Pre-Chorus]
I don't own a roller, Frank, I own a lot of samples

[Chorus]
Eggshell, not satin, I say it slow
Hold the chip to the window, let the colour show
Every wall in my flat is a shade of hello
Eggshell, not satin, mix me another, go

[Verse 2]
Now the bathroom's sage and the bedroom's something called Oat
My landlord left a voicemail, he says please stop painting
Frank writes my name on the lid with a marker
Spells it wrong on purpose so I'll come back and correct it

[Pre-Chorus]
I don't need a roller, Frank, I need a Saturday

[Chorus]
Eggshell, not satin, I say it slow
Hold the chip to the window, let the colour show
There's one wall left and you already know
Eggshell, not satin, come and help it go

[Outro - strings and clavinet fade]
Bring a brush on Sunday, Frank
I'll pick the colour, you pick the takeaway
